summary: Learn EU AI Act compliance, AI governance controls, and reporting tools in a practical 5-day training. Enrol to build readiness.
lede: AI regulation training helps governance, compliance, legal, risk, procurement, product, and data oversight professionals assess AI use and organize compliance evidence. Participants practice classifying use cases, mapping obligations to controls, building documentation records, and setting oversight, escalation, and reporting workflows for AI systems, including vendor-provided tools.
audienceIntro: This AI regulation course is for professionals who already touch governance, compliance, legal review, risk, procurement, product delivery, or data oversight and now need a practical way to manage EU AI Act obligations. It is especially useful if you are responsible for AI use cases, vendor assurance, control documentation, or reporting to senior decision-makers.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working familiarity with AI-enabled business processes, governance or compliance workflows, and basic risk terminology. You do not need programming skills, but you should be comfortable reviewing policies, control documents, vendor disclosures, and simple risk tables. Prior exposure to the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF 1.0, GDPR-aware data governance, or internal model approval processes will help, but it is not mandatory. Participants should bring a laptop for template-based exercises, and advance preparation should include identifying one AI use case from your organisation for workshop application.
